capability.title: Omni-channel Gateway
capability.summary: Every way work enters the system, in one place: a human messaging a bot, a webhook from a CRM or e-commerce platform, a schedule, or a direct API call. Its only jobs are to authenticate the source, mint a correctly-scoped Envelope, and hand off. It contains no marketing logic at all — that separation is why adding an intake channel never risks a production pipeline.

assignments.note: The same request within the same hour returns the in-flight run instead of starting a second one. Double-posting is the failure mode users notice most.
